methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was re-fetched via WebFetch on 2026-06-18. Published prices confirmed directly: Plytix (Standard $0, Pro $499/mo USD, Enterprise custom) and Pimberly (Regular/Pro/Corporate published as annual USD/GBP/EUR; monthly-equivalents derived and noted). Quote-only vendors (Sales Layer, Catsy, inriver, Bluestone PIM, Productsup, and Akeneo's Growth/Enterprise editions) verified to publish NO amounts; monthlyUsd set to null. Akeneo Community Edition confirmed free/open-source; akeneo.com/pricing returns 404 so the Community Edition page was used. Compliance set true only where the vendor's own page explicitly states it: inriver gdpr corrected to null (page states SOC2 Type II + ISO 27001:2022 + ISO 27701:2019 but does not explicitly claim GDPR); Productsup soc2 null (held only by its cloud host, not Productsup directly). No vendors were fabricated; all nine exist. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Plytix
vendors.provenance: Fetched plytix.com/pricing 2026-06-18: Standard $0, Pro $499/month (USD shown directly, not just EUR), Enterprise custom. Free version and SKU limits corroborated by Capterra listing (which loads, not 404). Official page is authoritative for the 500-SKU Standard limit (Capterra states 1,000 SKUs; official 500 used).

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Forever free. 500 SKUs, 500 AI credits/month, 5,000 API calls/hour, unlimited users, basic team management. No credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 50,000 SKUs, 500 AI credits/month, 15,000 API calls/hour, unlimited users, advanced team management. Official pricing page displays $499/mo USD (also shown in EUR by region). Billed monthly, cancel anytime.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited SKUs, custom AI credits, unlimited API calls/hour, unlimited users, multi-account support. Custom pricing — contact sales.

keyFeatures: Unlimited users on all plans
AI credits for product enrichment
Channel distribution add-ons (Marketplace feeds, Brand Portals)
Monthly billing with no lock-in
enrichment.provenance: Fetched plytix.com/pricing (live, prices published in USD) and corroborated free tier via Capterra (page loads). No security certification page was accessible; compliance left null.

plans.name: Premium

Fetched akeneo.com/akeneo-pim-community-edition: Community Edition confirmed free/open-source (trusted by 500+ customers, 80,000+ downloads, actively promoted — NO deprecation or wind-down language on the page). Growth Edition is quote-based, starting ~$25K/year per third-party sources (G2, StrikeTru). Enterprise is quote-only.

plans.notes: Free, open-source, self-hosted PIM. Standard PIM functions, REST and Events APIs, community connectors. Community support only — no dedicated support. Actively promoted by Akeneo (500+ customers, 80,000+ downloads).

plans.notes: SaaS PIM for fast-growing companies. Quote-based; third-party sources (G2, StrikeTru) cite a starting price around $25,000/year, but no amount is published officially. Includes advanced enrichment and connector ecosystem.

plans.name: Enterprise Edition

large enterprises needing full PIM governance

plans.name: Pro

plans.name: Corporate

plans.name: Enterprise

keyFeatures: Transparent published pricing (rare in enterprise PIM)
